answer_1.quote: We evaluate our Transformer model with differentiable window-based attention on a potpourri of NLP tasks, namely machine translation, sentiment analysis, language modeling, and subjectverb agreement.
answer_1.outputs: Translated sentences for machine translation; generated text sequences for language modeling

answer_2.quote: Notably, on the English-German and English-French WMT'14 translation tasks, our method accomplishes improvements of 0.63 and 0.85 BLEU, respectively... We further report improvements of... 2.13 points in perplexity on the language modeling tasks.
